newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Honeywell appoints Itallian as president.
newsitem.headline: Honeywell appoints Itallian as president.

text.p: Honeywell Inc said on Thursday Italian Giannantonio Ferrari would take over as president and chief operating officer in April when the current incumbent, D. Larry Moore, retires.
Ferrari, president of Brussels-based Honeywell Europe, has worked for the firm for 36-years -- moving from its official Italian distributor and agent Gavazzi SpA to Honeywell Italia in 1965.
He has held his current post for four years.
Ferrari will be replaced at Honeywell Europe by Vice President and Chief Financial Officier William Hjerpe.
Hjerpe's post will in turn be filled by Lawrence Stranhhoener, vice president of business development.
